introduction_to_the_system.one_paragraph: A composition is a vector of parts carrying only RELATIVE information (oxide fractions, energy mix, gas O2/CO2/N2, microbiome taxa, drive-health channels, blood gas, anything that is 'a few components of a whole tracked over time'). Traditional tools treat the parts as independent magnitudes; Hs treats the whole as a point in Aitchison (log-ratio) geometry and reads its DYNAMICS deterministically. At four parts the move is exactly a quaternion rotation; at higher dimension it is TILED from overlapping exact four-part charts and reconstructed losslessly (proven to D=1,000,000). Every step is deterministic and hash-chained: same input -> same output, with a receipt.
introduction_to_the_system.what_it_is: A deterministic compositional INSTRUMENT operating in Aitchison geometry on the simplex. It is an instrument, not a statistical model: it reads structure; the domain expert decides what it means.
introduction_to_the_system.the_one_big_idea: A 4-part composition has exactly 3 log-ratio degrees of freedom = the dimension of a unit quaternion (S^3 = SU(2)). So a 4-part move is read EXACTLY as a rotation. Higher-D is handled by tiling overlapping exact 4-part charts and stitching on shared parts (lossless iff the part co-occurrence graph is connected). The phylogeny/hierarchy is used as the tiling atlas where one exists.
what_it_does: Navigation read per step: K_eff = exp(Shannon) (effective number of carriers), helmsman = argmax|delta clr| (which part steers the change), regime boundaries (change-points), 'deceptive drift' (concentration tightening while motion stays quiet), bearing/angular velocity (atan2-stable), attractor fit.
Lossless high-D reconstruction (tens to millions of parts, exact + deterministic).
Self-diagnostics (FDIR): with >=2 redundant channels, tell an EXTERNAL change (world moved) from an INTERNAL fault (sensor failed) and isolate the channel.
A diagnostic code system (SS-CCC-LLL) incl. the automated NULL flag (DX-NUL-DIS: a null is a finding, not a failure).
Operational control: per-stage state (READY/RUNNING/HALTED/...) + start/halt, for embedded/flight use.
Provenance: a canonical content hash at every step; bit-for-bit reproducible across machines.
introduction_to_the_system.why_it_matters: Most high-D compositional tools reach for statistics and lossy reduction; they discard information and are not bit-reproducible. Hs is deterministic, lossless, and auditable, and it reads what magnitude/statistics methods cannot see deterministically -- which part steers, concentration tightening behind quiet motion, the exact rotational structure of a move -- each with a receipt. Suitable from a notebook to mission-critical and flight systems.
introduction_to_the_system.input: CSV: first column = an ordering label (time/depth/sample id); remaining columns = the parts (carriers). Values are counts or amounts; the engine closes them and treats zeros. Order rows for a trajectory.
introduction_to_the_system.output_blocks: atlas (lossless + reconstruction_max_err); navigation (per-step k_eff, helmsman, tv, regime, regime_boundaries); helmsman_family / attractor_fit / depth_tower; stages + navigation_2d (auto-omitted above D~64); diagnostics.cntt_content_sha256 (the receipt).
introduction_to_the_system.current_engine: CN-TT v4 (HCI-CNTT/) -- tile-native, the reference implementation of HUF-STD-002 (Tensor Train). The CNT v3.2.0 + CNQ v2.0.0 engines are the ARCHIVED frozen validation oracle (HCI-CNT/, HCI-CNQ/); CN-TT v4 reproduces their entire output bit-for-bit on real Backblaze data and is additive to them.
introduction_to_the_system.lineage: DADC -> Higgins Operator H1 -> HUF (MC-4 + EITT) -> Hs -> CNT -> CNQ -> CN-TT v4.

governance_you_must_follow.claim_tiers: Every claim carries one: Tier 1 (verified/computed), Tier 2 (standard math soundly applied), Tier 3 (to earn).
governance_you_must_follow.honest_broker: Report nulls straight (a null is a finding). 'Interest expressed, never acquired.' Inspected is NOT executed evidence -- never imply a run happened that didn't.
governance_you_must_follow.no_ai_commits_or_sends: Peter is the SOLE commit/contact gate. The AI commits nothing and sends nothing. All outreach letters are DRAFTs for his review.
governance_you_must_follow.instrument_not_data: Read data where it lives; never store or redistribute it. Derived compositions live OFF-repo (DATA/_derived/); only analysis outputs/figures/writeups go in the repo.
governance_you_must_follow.lockdown_additive: Do NOT edit the frozen oracle (HCI-CNT/engine/cnt.py, HCI-CNQ/engine/cnq.py), the schemas (HUF-STD-001/002/003), or the INV catalog. New work is additive.
governance_you_must_follow.carrier_filter: Personal/company contacts + private business development stay OFF the public repo (off-repo Pipeline-Projects/). E.g. the Southmedic dossier + Matthew Wehner's contact are off-repo.
governance_you_must_follow.communications_RWA_001: PeterHiggins@RogueWaveAudio.com -- Rogue Wave Audio / Binaural Test Lab -- Markham, Ontario, Canada.
governance_you_must_follow.ai_use: Developed with the HUF AI Collective under HUF-STD-001; human authorship for all claims.

gotchas: STALE-MOUNT: the sandbox/mount serves a truncated copy of the big admin JSONs (HS_ADMIN.json, HS_FAST_REFRESH.json, HS_TRACKING_LOG.json), so bash `json.load` FALSELY fails mid-file at a fixed-ish offset. The Read tool is authoritative; validate JSON on Peter's machine. (Also: large just-written files can read stale via bash -- execute python via heredoc/stdin, not the mounted .py, if a run mysteriously syntax-errors.)
MOUNT CANNOT DELETE DIRECTORIES (__pycache__, empty folders) -- gitignored anyway; Windows-side cleanup.
VERIFY BEFORE RECOMMENDING: a memory/handoff note reflects what was true when written -- if it names a file/function/flag, confirm it still exists.
QUARANTINED: the differential-geometry tower (curvature/holonomy/Chern-Simons/Berry/instanton) and the transcendental-constant 'findings' are out of ALL claims until earned / not publishable.
verify_quickstart: Reproduce a real-data run: e.g. industrial-instruments/gas-composition-study/produced-water-codawork/results_real_usgs/ (USGS) or collaborations/spaceflight-glds1/ (GLDS-1).
suggested_first_actions: Read the read_order chain; run the engine self-test to confirm a working environment.
Skim one real-data run README to feel how a study is structured (generator off-repo -> engine -> figure + writeup + claim tiers).

Then ask Peter what to tackle, or propose one of: (a) E-21 engine hardening (guard an all-zero/constant carrier + emit a CAL code; live engine only); (b) a real-data run on data already on disk (CapnoBase, another produced-water basin, mudstone geochemistry, an OSDR RNA-seq study); (c) the corpus-wide parity harness (P3).
